author: gap-fill
review_scope: Single AI author reads every selected idiom and its default key in context, then records positional polyphone decisions. Entries were chosen one by one from the jieba missing-common-word checklist (dict.txt, MIT), ranks 30001-100000, tag i, four characters, excluding names. This is not an independent human linguistic review and not a bulk import.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin 0.55.0 authoring-only; default agreement is not a review decision
frequency_policy: Fixed coarse project-relative category bands before native evaluation; no measured corpus frequencies or tuning to public answer ranks.
source_policy: Entries were selected one at a time from the jieba frequency checklist (dict.txt, MIT), not from a bulk import and not from tests/data. Names, fragments, and uncertain two-character leftovers were left out. Existing entries and weights were not modified.
